subject.title: improve(ui): drop the redundant desktop top bar and add back/forward navigation to the macOS app

question: Should OpenClaw adopt sidebar-only desktop Control UI navigation and native macOS WKWebView Back/Forward controls as the maintained direction for the linked request?
rationale: The implementation looks coherent, but deleting the desktop breadcrumb topbar is a user-visible product direction and the PR has the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Accept the focused PR
options.body: Merge after exact-head CI/proof confirms the web UI and macOS dashboard behavior.

options.title: Split the change
options.body: Ask for separate web-topbar and macOS-history PRs if maintainers want independent design or rollout decisions.

options.title: Keep the desktop breadcrumb
options.body: Reject or revise the branch if maintainers want a non-duplicative desktop location surface instead of deleting the row.

recommendation.title: Accept the focused PR
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head CI/proof confirms the web UI and macOS dashboard behavior.
